name: Fixed-wing UAV
description: Autonomous fixed-wing aircraft with a flight controller (autopilot) driving servos and a motor.

CHK-CONTROLLER-LOGS.question: Retrieve the flight-controller log (mode, failsafe and event messages) for this flight
CHK-CONTROLLER-LOGS.why: A failsafe, mode change or output override at the onset is recorded only by the flight controller.

CHK-NETWORK-LOGS.question: Export telemetry-link logs (signal strength, packet loss) for the flight

CHK-ONSITE-ACTUATOR.question: Inspect the servo, linkage and control surface on the airframe

CHK-CLOCK-OFFSET.question: Establish the clock offset between the ground station and the flight controller
CHK-CLOCK-OFFSET.why: Without a bounded offset between ground-station and flight-controller clocks, delays between a command sent and its effect on the aircraft cannot be measured.

CHK-CONFIRM-CONTEXT.question: Confirm the airframe model, autopilot firmware and parameter set for this flight

points.label: Pilot or ground station
points.if_missing: The pilot's transmitter inputs are not recorded: whether the pilot commanded the change cannot be read.

points.label: Telemetry and command link
points.if_missing: The link between operator and machine is not measured: delays or losses on it cannot be read.

points.label: Flight controller (mode, setpoints, configuration)
points.if_missing: The flight controller's mode, configuration and messages are not recorded.

points.label: Servo and throttle commands as the flight controller reports them
points.if_missing: The controller's output commands are not recorded.

points.label: Servos and motor actually moving
points.if_missing: No servo position or motor feedback is recorded: whether a control surface or the motor did what was commanded cannot be read from this recording.

points.label: Aircraft motion (attitude, airspeed, altitude)
points.if_missing: The machine's motion is not measured.

mechanisms.label: Pilot stick input
mechanisms.needs: The pilot's transmitter inputs at the onset

mechanisms.label: Telemetry or command link delay or loss
mechanisms.needs: Link quality and command timing records for the window

mechanisms.label: Flight controller behaviour (mode change, configuration, failsafe or control logic)
mechanisms.needs: The flight-controller log (mode, event, failsafe and parameter records) at the onset

mechanisms.label: Servo output path (servo, wiring, ESC): command not carried out
mechanisms.needs: Servo position feedback, or a check of the servo, linkage and wiring

mechanisms.label: Airframe, control surface, propulsion or air: the surface moves but the aircraft does not respond as expected
mechanisms.needs: Servo feedback alongside the motion, or an inspection of the surface, linkage and propulsion

mechanisms.label: Sensor error: the aircraft flew normally but a sensor reported otherwise
mechanisms.needs: A second, independent measurement of the same motion (e.g. GNSS against the inertial estimate)
